response.sql: WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS mix_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT mix, mix_count, CAST(mix_count AS REAL) / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts), compared AS (SELECT mix, mix_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT mix, mix_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY share DESC, mix;
